Super tahimik (like, no annoying clicking sound at all), tapos ergonomic pa, so hindi masakit sa kamay kahit long hours kang nagwo-work or nagga-game. Plus, adjustable yung DPI, so you can tweak the sensitivity depende sa need mo—whether chill browsing lang or something more precise like editing. Battery life? Crazy long! Isang AA battery lang, tapos good for months (or even a year daw, pero di ko pa natetest that long lol). Super plug-and-play din, so no setup stress. Downsides? Walang Bluetooth (so USB receiver lang talaga siya), at wala siyang kasamang battery, which is kinda meh pero di naman dealbreaker. Overall, if you want a quiet, comfy, and super reliable wireless mouse for work or study, this one’s a solid buy! 💯
